name: Brynhild
subtitle: Exiled Valkyrie
description: Protect your allies with Radiant Power whilst reflecting Blaze back upon your foes.
lore: Banished from the ranks of the Valkyrie, Brynhild proved a fearsome warrior, but the anger that drove her grew only greater as she was deceived and manipulated by various mortal factions. In Ryven, she has been restored to her former glory, but her greatest battles are not against Asgard’s foes, but against her own rage and jealous pride.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when hit by an enemy.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Awaken the ability: Ring of Flames
Attunement Multiplier +25%, Armor Multiplier +15%, Weapon Multiplier +15%
Awaken the ability: Reading the Runes

skills.name: Power Lance
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (175%DEF+80%ATK). Has a 50% chance to place [mechanic:atk-down-ii] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Reading the Runes
skills.description: Place [mechanic:def-up-ii] for 2 turns on all allies, then place [mechanic:intercept] on the ally with the lowest HP for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: Place [Intercept] on all allies except this hero instead.

skills.name: Ring of Flames
skills.description: Removes all [Disables] from this hero, then place [mechanic:radiance-ii] on all allies for 2 turns. Can be used while under a [Disable].

skills.name: Vengeful Valkyrie
skills.description: While under a [Radiance] buff, place [mechanic:blaze-ii] for 1 turn on any enemy that attacks this hero.

skills.name: Valkyrie's Aegis
skills.description: When an ally's HP falls below 50%, place [mechanic:shield]20%HP on them.

imprint_passive: When this hero's HP falls below 50%, place [Shield]10%HP on them.
